declarations.name: BxDataList
declarations.description:
`<bx-data-list>` — virtualized list / grid for feeds, inboxes and galleries
(docs/features/data-list/data-list.md), built on core's `VirtualizerController`.

Items are plain data (`items`, or pages pulled through `data-source`); the list renders only
the rows near the viewport, with `renderItem(item, index)` supplying each item's template.
Rows are measured (`item-height="auto"`, the default) with scroll anchoring, or fixed
(`item-height` in px, which includes any gap). Grid layout derives its column count from the
*container's* inline size (`floor((width + gap) / (min-item-width + gap))`, via the shared
`ResizeObserver`), so list → grid → list happens without breakpoints. `group-by` inserts group
header rows; the header covering the viewport top is rendered `position: sticky`.

**Accessibility.** `role="list"`/`listitem`, or `listbox`/`option` once the list is selectable or
reorderable, with `aria-setsize`/`aria-posinset` from data indexes. Focus stays on the viewport
and the active item is announced with `aria-activedescendant` (the item node is pinned in the
window so it survives scrolling). Arrows/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown move, Space or Enter select
(Shift extends a range, Ctrl+A selects all in `multiple`), typing jumps by `item-label`. A polite
live region announces each loaded batch.

**Reorder (FR-DATA-LIST-05).** With `reorderable`: Space picks up the active item, arrows move
it, Space drops, Escape cancels (so Enter is the select key then). Pointer drag starts after a
4 px threshold, auto-scrolls near the viewport edges and drops on release. Both emit
`bx-reorder` and move the item in the list's own copy; assign `items` again to resync.

**Reverse (FR-DATA-LIST-03).** `direction="reverse"` starts at the bottom, keeps the viewport
pinned to the bottom as items arrive unless the user scrolled up, and loads older items when
scrolled near the top while keeping what the user is reading in place.

Gaps, per docs/features/_conventions.md's "say so inline" rule: `layout="masonry"` is rendered
as `grid` (true column-packing needs per-column virtualization, which the shared virtualizer
does not do); the spec's `item` *slot* is replaced by the `renderItem` property (a slotted
template cannot be instantiated per item); `item-height` fixes the row height in px.

attributes.name: item-label
attributes.description: Field name or function giving an item's text for typeahead.

members.name: items
members.description: Data items (ignored while `data-source` is set; pages accumulate internally then).

members.name: itemLabel
members.description: Field name or function giving an item's text for typeahead.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Discards loaded pages (when a data source is set) and reloads from the start.

members.name: invalidateItem
members.description: Re-measures one item (its content changed height).

events.name: bx-item-click
events.description: An item was activated. `detail: { item, index, key }`.

events.name: bx-reorder
events.description: An item moved. `detail: { item, key, from, to }`.

events.name: bx-range-change
events.description: The rendered item range changed. `detail: { start, end }`.

events.name: bx-load-more
events.description: Scrolled near the end (the start in `reverse`). With `data-source` the next page is also requested automatically.

events.name: bx-data-error
events.description: A `data-source` request failed. `detail: { error }`; call `refresh()` or scroll to retry.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Shown when there are no items.

declarations.name: BxVirtualTree
declarations.description:
`<bx-virtual-tree>` — virtualized tree for 100k+ nodes with lazy children, filtering and
multi-selection (docs/features/data-list/virtual-tree.md). The data-driven counterpart to
`bx-tree`: nodes are plain objects and only the visible rows exist in the DOM.

**Model (FR-VIRTUAL-TREE-01/03).** The tree is indexed once into pre-order arrays (parent,
depth, subtree end, leaf and selected-leaf counts). Because a subtree is a contiguous range,
the visible rows are produced by *skipping* collapsed subtrees (cost: visible rows, not total
nodes) and a branch's tri-state is two integers — toggling a branch updates its range and
walks the ancestors, never touching DOM or unrendered components. The visible-row array feeds
core's `VirtualizerController`; the row that has focus is pinned in the window.

**Lazy loading (FR-VIRTUAL-TREE-04).** A node with `hasChildren: true` and no `children` loads on
first expand through `data-source.getChildren(key, signal)`, with a per-node loading/error
state: a failed node shows an error row and Enter/click retries. Without a data source the
element emits `bx-lazy-load` and the app answers with `setChildren(key, nodes)` /
`setLoadError(key)`.

**Filtering (FR-VIRTUAL-TREE-02).** `filter` (a substring, case-insensitive, or a predicate)
keeps matches and their ancestors, and ancestors auto-expand. It runs on the main thread in one
linear pass over the pre-order arrays (no Worker); that is a few ms at 200k nodes.

**Selection.** `single` (any node), `multiple` (a branch selects every leaf below it and shows a
mixed state while partly selected) and `leaf` (only leaves are selectable; clicking a branch
toggles it open). `selectedKeys` always lists leaf keys (or the one key in `single`).

**Accessibility.** ARIA tree: `role="tree"`/`treeitem`, `aria-level`/`setsize`/`posinset`
computed from data, `aria-expanded`, `aria-selected`/`aria-checked`. Focus stays on the tree and
the active node is exposed with `aria-activedescendant`. Arrows/Home/End/`*`/typeahead per the
APG tree pattern; Space toggles selection, Enter activates.

Gaps, per docs/features/_conventions.md's "say so inline" rule: tree-*table* mode (secondary
columns with priority hiding) is not implemented; the spec's `node` slot is the `renderNode`
property (a slotted template cannot be instantiated per node); `expand-icon`/`collapse-icon` slots
are not provided (the chevron is a CSS-rotated glyph).

type.text:
(
    node: TreeNode<T>,
    context: TreeNodeContext,
  ) => TemplateResult | string

members.name: expandAll
members.description: Expands every branch down to `depth` levels (0 = roots only). Default: all.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Discards lazily-loaded children and errors, and rebuilds the tree from `nodes`.

members.name: setChildren
members.description: Supplies children for a lazy node (when not using `data-source`).

members.name: setLoadError
members.description: Marks a lazy node's load as failed; its row offers a retry.

events.name: bx-node-click
events.description: A node was activated. `detail: { key, node }`.

events.name: bx-lazy-load
events.description: A lazy node was expanded. `detail: { key, signal }`.

events.name: bx-range-change
events.description: The rendered row range changed. `detail: { start, end }`.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Shown when no node is visible.

cssParts.name: indent
cssParts.description: The indentation (and guide) area of a row.

cssProperties.description: Indent per level.
